test_title: PYST 5: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

WASH - HSWA - WSAH

CORE - ERCO - CROE
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Rearrange letters in a specific pattern**

**First word → Second word:**

Letters are rearranged in the order **4 – 3 – 1 – 2**

**Second word → Third word:**

Letters are rearranged in the order **3 – 2 – 4 – 1**

**Given,**

WASH → HSWA → WSAH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21c796a2b78a8074e51113baf420ff3da1d085b454908ce15d1f19bb43e42b44.png] 

CORE → ERCO → CROE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb4e35dbfe62f6f428c4d0515082aafa551d4e37bc712ecc557e262eaaff33f5.png] 

Now, checking the options:

**Option 1) INKS → SKIN → IKNS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a855d38fc5ddf5c0c06142e3897947f272851489b1119fa9989f3b727087edb4.png] 

Option 2) LEAP → LAEP → PAEL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a46a0ff7764bf9476315a99f4549c95c46e73e46464c44787d1542ece588dae4.png] 

Option 3) DARE → ARDE → ARED

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27e57931757c96f127a674224c184dc4eddf9b4c41929b50b9965435087e68c7.png] 

Option 4) FINE → ENFI → INFE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f20491936a30396c36d63b9a3eed18781b99032504a00085c4c5ba587174b2d.png] 

**Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".**
